name: agent-control-plane
description: Agent Control Plane: route tasks to coding-agent harnesses (opencode/claude/codex/dsh) with model+effort control. Control-plane code has zero npm deps; the harness adapters it drives are optional peers.

scripts.test:unit: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const n=fs.readdirSync('tests/unit').filter(function(f){return f.endsWith('.test.ts')}).length;if(n===0){console.error('test:unit: no *.test.ts found under tests/unit');process.exit(1)};console.log('test:unit: '+n+' file(s)')" && node --test --experimental-strip-types "tests/unit/**/*.test.ts"
